plain_english: The Position Sizing Engine converts module-level risk outputs into a recommended capital fraction. It first computes weighted risk from volatility, drawdown, VaR/CVaR, contagion, liquidity, and regime risk. The weighted risk is mapped to a size bucket. Technical confidence may scale the position within the allowed range, but hard caps from regime, liquidity, drawdown, VaR/CVaR, contagion, and volatility can only reduce exposure. Risk caps always override optimistic signals.
